patterns: Tell me about Project X VJTI
responses: Project X is an innovation-driven club at VJTI, Mumbai. We focus on bringing together students interested in technology and creativity.
Project X VJTI is dedicated to building and showcasing innovative projects and ideas. We promote collaboration and learning through workshops and events.

patterns: What events does Project X organize?
What events are happening at Project X?
responses: Project X regularly organizes workshops, hackathons, and tech talks. Check out our website and social media for the latest updates.
We host various events throughout the year including hackathons, coding challenges, and workshops on emerging technologies.
